audit.whatIsWrong: Rated FAVOURED, difficulty 4/10, on a lane Nasus loses at 48.51% over 604 games — and the entry's own level chart gives Illaoi six of seven stages.
audit.why: Every other field in the entry describes a losing lane ('Illaoi owns these levels and you cannot contest it', 'you are playing not to die'), the chart gives her everything up to two items, and the win rate is under 50. FAVOURED 4/10 is the only thing claiming otherwise, and it is the field a player reads first.
audit.corrected: diffRating 7/10, breakdown.difficulty and the final rating line corrected. diff itself must go FAVOURED to HARD by hand — see notes, the length rule blocks it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere says where tentacles come from.
audit.why: Riot's text for Prophet of an Elder God: 'Illaoi and the Vessels she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain.' Tentacles need a wall. Last-hitting from the open middle of the lane rather than hugging terrain physically reduces how many tentacles can reach the fight, and dragging the duel into open ground is the concrete version of the advice the entry already gives in vague form ('fight off her field').
audit.corrected: Stated in the early text, in wants.you[0] and in the first-item stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit's range is never given, and neither is Wither's.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 900 range; Wither is 700. She outranges Nasus's only interaction tool by 200 units, which is why 'walk up and Wither her' is not available as an opener and why the entry's advice to punish only a missed E is correct.
audit.corrected: Range gap stated in breakdown.cooldowns, early and wants.you[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Defect list: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. The entry says 'punish a wild E' without ever saying how long the punish lasts, and never distinguishes which of her cooldowns is actually punishable.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s — a missed one at rank 1 hands Nasus sixteen seconds. Harsh Lesson, by contrast, is a flat 4 seconds and makes every nearby tentacle swing at its target, so it is never the cooldown you wait out. Naming the right one is the difference between a free window and walking into a tentacle field.
audit.corrected: 16s stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull and the mid-game text; Harsh Lesson's 4s named in dontsFull.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line, despite _missing-interactions.json flagging needs-antiheal for this pairing.
audit.why: Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi whenever her tentacles damage a champion, and Harsh Lesson makes every nearby tentacle swing on a 4s cooldown. In exactly the long, stacked-Q duel the entry tells the player to seek at two items, that healing is what decides it.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to the late-game text and to dontsFull.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[4] 'Level 6' calls it 'the first real fight you're allowed to take' and gives the stage to Nasus, while the content layer for the same stage says 'hold ult for survival ... back off rather than greed a stack' and gives it to Illaoi.
audit.why: These are opposite instructions for the same moment. Leap of Faith into a stacked tentacle field is Illaoi's single strongest all-in; telling a Nasus his level-6 R makes it winnable will get him killed. The content layer is right.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten to survival-only. The .side field cannot be fixed — see notes.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Test of Spirit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Test of Spirit and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Illaoi carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10, Illaoi carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Dodging this denies her sustain. Avoid it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — 900 range, 16s at rank 1, and it outranges Wither by 200. Punish the miss.

edits.before: Fury of the Sands flips dives: pop R, Wither Illaoi, and suddenly the stat-check runs your way. First real fight you're allowed to take.
edits.after: Fury of the Sands is survival here, not a kill: Leap of Faith on a full tentacle field out-damages your lifesteal. Wither her, then walk away.

edits.before: Sheen-item spike — Q now chunks a third of Illaoi's HP through the Wither slow. The lane bully phase is over; she knows it.
edits.after: Sheen-item spike — but only off her field. Tentacles spawn on nearby walls, so drag the duel into open lane before you commit.

edits.before: That is Illaoi's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: Harsh Lesson is 4s and makes every nearby tentacle swing at you — never trade there.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her tentacles heal her every time they hit you — Grievous Wounds before you duel.

edits.before: Illaoi wastes Test of Spirit — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1; a miss is your whole punish window.

edits.before: Illaoi owns these levels and you cannot contest it — you have no Wither until 3 and zero stacks, so just soak Q farm at the very tip and refuse to walk into E (Test of Spirit) range. If she rips your spirit you have to run from your own tentacles, eating free damage, so respect the cast and keep tentacles on your flank, never between you and the wave. Your Soul Eater lifesteal sustains the passive poke, but do not trade — there is no trade you win here, only chip you survive.
edits.after: Illaoi owns these levels and you cannot contest it — you have no Wither until 3 and zero stacks, so just soak Q farm at the very tip and refuse to walk into Test of Spirit (E) range, which is 900 to Wither's 700. If she rips your spirit you have to run from your own tentacles, eating free damage, so respect the cast and keep tentacles on your flank, never between you and the wave. Tentacles only spawn on nearby walls, so last-hit from the open middle of the lane, never hugging terrain.

edits.before: Still her window. Wither at 3 lets you peel a gank or punish a wild E, but extended trades on her tentacle field grind you down and her sustain refills faster than your stacks matter yet. At 6 her R plus a stacked field is lethal — if she E-pulls you near tentacles she can burst you before Fury of the Sands lifesteal kicks in, so hold ult for survival, Wither her the instant she ults, and back off rather than greed a stack. Keep farming; you are playing not to die.
edits.after: Still her window. Wither at 3 lets you peel a gank or punish a missed Test of Spirit — that miss is 16 seconds at rank 1 and the only free window you get. Extended trades on her tentacle field still grind you down and her tentacle healing refills her faster than your stacks matter yet. At 6, Leap of Faith on a stacked field is lethal, so hold ult for survival, Wither her the instant she ults, and back off rather than greed a stack. You are playing not to die.

edits.before: This is where you reclaim it. With Iceborn/Trinity, infinite Q stacks and Wither, you slow her to a crawl, drag the duel off her tentacles, and out-sustain her AoE in a long fight — she is immobile and weak the moment she is pulled off her field. She has no percent-HP or true damage, so your fat HP bar and lifesteal simply win the splitpush 1v1. Just never fight her standing in a full tentacle field, and never face her R cooldown without your Wither up.
edits.after: This is where you reclaim it. With Iceborn/Trinity, infinite Q stacks and Wither, you slow her to a crawl, drag the duel off her tentacles, and out-sustain her in a long fight — she is immobile and weak the moment she is pulled off her field. Her tentacles heal her on every hit they land, so Grievous Wounds is the item that decides the long duel. Just never fight her standing in a full tentacle field, and never face her R cooldown without your Wither up.

edits.before: Fury of the Sands lets you SURVIVE one committed dive, but her R plus full field still out-damages your lifesteal — Wither and disengage, do not duel.
edits.after: Fury of the Sands lets you SURVIVE one committed dive, but Leap of Faith on a full field still out-damages your lifesteal — Wither and disengage, never duel.

edits.before: Her R plus a full tentacle field is her hardest all-in; if she lands E on you near tentacles she can delete you before your Fury of the Sands lifesteal can answer.
edits.after: Leap of Faith on a full tentacle field is her hardest all-in; a Test of Spirit landed near tentacles deletes you before Fury of the Sands lifesteal can answer.

edits.before: Soak Q farm at max range and never get hit by her E (Test of Spirit) near a tentacle
edits.after: Soak Q farm in open lane — tentacles need walls, and Test of Spirit outranges Wither

edits.before: Use Wither to peel her ult dive and walk the fight away from her tentacle field
edits.after: Wither her Leap of Faith dive and walk the fight away from her tentacle field

notes: TWO FIXES THE LENGTH RULE BLOCKS, both need doing by hand. (1) full diff is "FAVOURED" and must become "HARD" — 8 chars to 4 is outside the plus/minus 10% band so I did not propose it, but leaving FAVOURED next to the corrected 7/10 rating is contradictory. (2) full phases[4].side and phases[5].side are "Nasus" while content win[4] and win[5] are "Illaoi" — "Nasus" to "Illaoi" is 5 chars to 6 and also out of band. Those two stages are the level-6 and first-item windows, i.e. exactly where a wrong call gets the player killed on her tentacle field. More generally, full phases[].side for this matchup reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Nasus/Nasus/Nasus while content win[] reads Illaoi x6 then Nasus; the two layers disagree on nearly every stage.
